historical_record.description: The building at 2103 Scott Street was built in 1890 and was in commercial use for most of its existence.
The commercial building was used as an employment agency.
After standing empty, the commercial building was in use as an antique shop.
A small commercial building, which looked to have been built as a garage, was being used to store antiques; three dwelling units and a garage stood behind it on the same lot.
The City Planning Commission extended the building's nonconforming commercial status by five years, to May 1975, with conditions, for use as a real estate office.
